The expiry threshold for pseudonymised Matches/Meta and Draft contributions is 730 days from receipt on the server; for Research it is 730 days from the first receipt, even if the contribution is updated. Scheduled maintenance deletes expired contributions: matches, complete Drafts, Research contributions and the linked data. If work piles up or there is an interruption, completion can take several cycles. A Research contribution deleted because it expired cannot be sent again. Expiry does not withdraw Research consent: you can keep sending new matches, withdraw consent or ask for deletion separately. Public data is recalculated only from the contributions still kept.
Gli allegati dei ticket chiusi vengono e: Attachments of closed tickets are deleted after 90 days and the whole closed ticket after 365 days. Website sign-in stays valid for up to 30 days; sign-in and linking codes expire after 10 minutes. Account data stays until the account is deleted.

Le tue partite e i tuoi Draft partono so: Your matches and Drafts are sent only for the features you turn on in Options. Connections for updates, statistics and images are something else and also happen with sharing turned off. The matches and Drafts you share do not contain your name or Arena account, passwords, chat or your opponent's hidden cards: they are linked to a random code, so you can ask for them to be deleted. ): contiene anche il tuo nome e account: ): it also contains your name and Arena account and is sent only if you choose to put it in the diagnostic package of a support ticket. Only the person who opened the ticket and the support team can see it.
MOX si collega al tuo account soltanto c: MOX links to your account only with a one-time code you generate and a key saved on your PC, even if you share nothing. Tickets opened with an account stay in the account; tickets opened without one are reopened with a secret link and are protected by an anti-spam check. Email notifications are optional: the address is requested only for that ticket, after an explicit checkbox and a confirmation from the message you receive. Emails do not contain the ticket text or attachments, only a private link to open it; the address and confirmation codes are deleted together with the ticket.
I contributi sono pseudonimizzati: ogni: Contributions are pseudonymised: each installation uses a random code instead of a name. The secret code needed to delete them is stored on the server only in a form from which the code cannot be worked out.
Research non invia nomi, il nome che dai: Research does not send names, the name you give your deck, the original match code, passwords or email, or your opponent's unrevealed hand or deck. If the Research service is not ready to receive data, MOX does not send it and keeps the matches on your PC.
Dopo che hai ritirato il consenso Resear: After you withdraw Research consent, MOX starts no new Research uploads. If the settings on your PC turn out to be damaged, MOX recovers what it can but treats Matches/Meta, Draft and «Decks in your account» as off until you choose them again.
